messages:
Elena (CEO): Quick follow-up from today
Devon (VP Product): Thanks for the great Qs. Short list of clarifications below.
Jorge (PM): I'll own publishing the expanded roadmap snapshot by Mon 03/29.
Ava (Design): We heard requests for clearer rollout visuals 12; prototype linked here: https://figma.com/file/redwood-rollouts-proto (comments open).
Marcus (Eng Manager): Perf note: working toward P95 < 70ms for small-gen on Dedicated. Will post an initial benchmark next Thursday.
Priya (SRE): Ops FYI: Dedicated failover drill scheduled 04/12-04/13. Tag critical routes to include them.
Sam (Data Scientist): On eval alerts: plan is opt-in signal webhooks + dashboard. Security gating in progress.
Devon (VP Product): Answers to two quick FAQ items: 1) multi-region Dedicated is a follow-up, not in initial launch; 2) embedding migration helper script will be published (small CLI).
Elena (CEO): Finance update: no hosted pricing changes planned this quarter.
infra-bot: "deploy" posted: console v0.9 canary starting. Smoke tests queued.
Marcus (Eng Manager): Seeing a small regression in "route_init_time" on the canary. Investigating.
Jorge (PM): Captured top customer asks: private onboarding, audit exports, rollout controls, cost dashboards, longer logs retention. Will map to roadmap items.
Devon (VP Product): Action list (owners + dates):
```
- @Jorge -> publish roadmap snapshot (03/29)
- @Marcus -> perf benchmark + PR (04/02)
- @Ava -> rollout visuals iteration (04/10)
- @Priya -> include tagged routes in failover drill (04/12)
- @Sam -> follow up on eval telemetry security review
```
Please ack with :white_check_mark: if you own your item.
Elena (CEO): We'll host a 30-min AMA next Thu 11am PT. Drop any leftover Qs here or in the shared doc: https://docs.google.com/redwood-allhands-ama.
Devon (VP Product): If you asked a question during the live Q&A and didn't get a reply, repost it here and I'll triage.
Marcus (Eng Manager): I'll post a link to the perf dashboard when the traces are in.
Elena (CEO): Thanks all 10. Small ask: react with :eyes: once you've read this thread so we know it landed.
